tasks.title: [EGRESS-02] Sweep closed smoltcp sockets from the SocketSet
tasks.description: Closed/TimeWait sockets are never removed (no sockets.remove in crates/speck-net/src); each connection leaks ~2MB and grows the 5ms scan.
tasks.details: Files: crates/speck-net/src/{lib.rs,reorigin.rs,port_publish.rs,tcp_listener.rs}. After close(), remove the handle once state is Closed/TimeWait (periodic sweep in the poll loop), drop bridge entry. Verify: unit test opening/closing N connections asserts SocketSet size stays flat; cargo test -p speck-net.

tasks.title: [EGRESS-01] Re-originate guest TCP to any destination port
tasks.description: Only ports 443 (8) and 80 (4) have smoltcp listeners (speck-net/src/lib.rs:108-115); ssh/DB/ES/custom ports fail.
tasks.details: Approach: sniff inbound guest frames for TCP SYN to a port without a listener and create a listener on demand before smoltcp processes the frame (any_ip already covers all dst IPs). Keep 443/80 pre-warm. Verify: scripts/egress-smoke.sh TCP 22/5432/9200/8443/27017 PASS; conformance-smoke 26/26.

tasks.title: [EGRESS-03] RST on host connect failure + bounded connect timeout
tasks.description: Failed host connect closes guest socket with FIN after handshake; no connect timeout (reorigin.rs:180-183,257).
tasks.details: Use tokio::time::timeout around TcpStream::connect (~10s), socket.abort() (RST) instead of close() on failure and for 127.x/gateway destinations (reorigin.rs:233-241). Verify: unit test; container nc to a refusing host port fails fast.

tasks.title: [EGRESS-04] UDP re-origination via 5-tuple NAT table
tasks.description: No guest UDP egress except DHCP and vsock DNS; NTP/QUIC/any UDP fails.
tasks.details: New crates/speck-net/src/udp_reorigin.rs: per-5-tuple flows, host tokio UdpSocket per flow, idle timeout ~60s, cap on flows. Exclude the DNS path. Verify: egress-smoke udp 123 (ntp) PASS + unit tests.

tasks.title: [EGRESS-06] Stop faking ICMP echo replies
tasks.description: Netstack answers pings to any IP locally in ~0.2ms (even 192.0.2.1), so container ping health checks lie.
tasks.details: Find the smoltcp auto-reply (any_ip + iface ICMP echo). Forward via unprivileged host ICMP datagram socket (SOCK_DGRAM IPPROTO_ICMP, no root on macOS) or drop. Verify: egress-smoke 'icmp not faked: ok'.

tasks.title: [EGRESS-05] Event-driven netstack poll loop
tasks.description: Poll loop wakes every 5ms forever (lib.rs:119) - constant CPU/battery cost; per-frame Vec allocations.
tasks.details: Use iface.poll_delay() for the timeout, wake on fd readiness and host bridge readiness; reuse buffers. Verify: idle CPU of spk near 0; no regression in egress-smoke/conformance or large docker pull throughput.

tasks.title: [OPS-04] Publish initrd release matching HEAD guest
tasks.description: Public initrd-1.3.0 (2026-07-09) predates the transparent proxy and Phase 25; a clean install on another Mac gets a mismatched guest.
tasks.details: Build initrd from the HEAD guest, publish initrd-1.4.0 GitHub release, bump INITRD_VERSION in crates/speck-cli/src/commands/up.rs, release spk. Verify: fresh SPECK_HOME on dev Mac, spk up --wait, conformance-smoke 26/26.

tasks.title: [RES-01] Daemon exits when the VM stops or errors
tasks.description: run_up waits only for SIGINT/SIGTERM (up.rs:~880); VM death leaves a 'running' daemon and launchd KeepAlive never fires.
tasks.details: Forward delegate stop/error events (speck-vz delegate.rs, vm_thread.rs apply_delegate_event) to a channel, select on it in run_up, exit non-zero. Add ThrottleInterval to the LaunchAgent plist. Verify: unit test; manual kill VM -> launchd restarts Speck.

tasks.title: [RES-05] Guest DNS forwarder: TCP:53, >512B answers, concurrent queries
tasks.description: Guest dns_forwarder.rs only listens on UDP:53 with a 512-byte buffer and handles one query at a time over a single vsock connection; >512B answers reach clients truncated (google.com TXT: 7 of 17 records) and one slow lookup blocks all guest DNS.
tasks.details: speck-guest/src/dns_forwarder.rs: add a TCP:53 listener (length-prefixed, RFC 7766) sharing the vsock connection under a mutex or a second vsock connection; raise DNS_BUF_SIZE to 4096. For concurrency, match responses by DNS ID or open one vsock connection per in-flight query (host spawn_dns_proxy then accepts multiple). Needs an initrd rebuild (ties into OPS-04 release). Verify: egress-smoke 'dns large answer (>512B)' PASS; concurrent slow lookups do not block each other.

tasks.title: [RES-06] DNS on user-defined networks (docker compose)
tasks.description: Compose networks had no DNS: guest forwarder replied from the wrong source address (unconnected 0.0.0.0 UDP socket). Fixed with IP_PKTINFO in commit 1dfeaec.
tasks.details: Found while testing TLS-03. Gate: egress-smoke 'dns on user network' (verified failing on the old guest). Ships with the next initrd release (OPS-04).

tasks.title: [OPS-04a] CI initrd build must include mke2fs/blkid/resize2fs
tasks.description: Published initrd-1.3.0 (295 KB, 11 entries) contains only /init; vminitd needs /sbin/mke2fs and /sbin/blkid to format the blank data disk on first boot (mount.rs, .expect on spawn -> PID 1 panic) and /sbin/resize2fs to grow it. Local dev initrds work only because scripts/provision-guest-resize-tools.sh added the tools.
tasks.details: Port provision-guest-resize-tools.sh into .github/workflows/build-initrd.yml (alpine apks: blkid e2fsprogs e2fsprogs-extra e2fsprogs-libs libblkid libcom_err libuuid into initrd_root). Verify locally first: build the release-equivalent cpio, boot a fresh SPECK_HOME with --kernel/--rootfs/--initrd/--data-disk overrides and a blank data disk, conformance-smoke 26/26. Blocks OPS-04 (#7).

tasks.title: [UX-01] spk up selects a 'speck' docker context like colima
tasks.description: colima start creates and selects a 'colima' docker context; spk up did nothing, so docker kept talking to the previous runtime.
tasks.details: Create/update context 'speck' (host=unix://$SPECK_HOME/speck.sock) and select it when the daemon is up; switch back to 'default' on spk down only if 'speck' is current. Skip with a log line when the docker CLI is missing. Warn when DOCKER_HOST overrides contexts.

tasks.title: [UX-02] Refresh stale guest assets automatically
tasks.description: After an upgrade spk up refused to start with 'run spk up --pull'; colima users never do that.
tasks.details: When initrd.version / rootfs.version differ from the binary's versions, download the new asset instead of failing. Container data lives on data.img and is kept.

tasks.title: [UX-03] colima-style commands: start/stop/delete
tasks.description: spk uses up/down; colima users type start/stop/restart/status/delete.
tasks.details: start = alias of up; stop without arguments stops Speck (with container arguments keeps stopping containers); delete removes the VM disks and docker context after confirmation (--force skips it).

tasks.title: [REL-01] Release spk v1.4.0 and update Homebrew formula
tasks.description: Last binary release is v1.3.2 (July); Formula/spk.rb still points at 0.1.0.
tasks.details: Bump workspace version to 1.4.0, tag v1.4.0 (release.yml builds artifacts), update the formula url/sha256, verify brew install + spk start on a clean SPECK_HOME.

tasks.title: [EGRESS-07] Forward guest ICMP echo through the host
tasks.description: ping from containers fails since the fake smoltcp echo reply was disabled (EGRESS-06); guest ICMP was never forwarded.
tasks.details: Intercept guest ICMPv4 echo requests in FdDevice, send them from the host via an unprivileged ICMP datagram socket per (destination, identifier), craft echo replies back to the guest from the original destination. Verify: container ping 1.1.1.1 works with real RTT, ping 192.0.2.1 still times out, egress-smoke gains a real ping check.

tasks.title: [UX-04] colima-style status/list/version/prune
tasks.description: Users need colima's 'status -e/-j', 'list', 'version' and 'prune' equivalents to see what Speck is doing.
tasks.details: spk status: running state, CPUs/memory/disk (allocated + used), docker version, socket, docker context, uptime; --extended adds versions (spk, initrd, rootfs, kernel), guest memory/disk usage, network mode; --json for scripts. spk list (single instance, colima list columns). spk version (spk, docker server, initrd, rootfs). spk prune: delete cached downloaded assets not in use. Verify with unit tests for formatting and live runs.

tasks.title: [FIX-1.4.2] Work-Mac findings: ports after restart, graceful VM stop, concurrent DNS
tasks.description: Ports re-exposed from inspect on start/restart/startup; vminitd shutdown listener (vsock 9008) stops dockerd + sync before power-off; DNS proxy/forwarder concurrent with ID tagging, VPN direct query 1s x2; getaddrinfo failure falls back to system nameservers; doctor dns 'n' bug; spk down with custom SPECK_HOME. Released spk 1.4.2 + initrd 1.4.2.

tasks.title: [FIX-1.4.3] linux/amd64 images via Rosetta
tasks.description: amd64 run/build failed with exec format error (no emulation, binfmt_misc not mounted). Host shares VZLinuxRosettaDirectoryShare (tag rosetta); vminitd mounts binfmt_misc and registers Rosetta (flags CF). Released spk 1.4.3 + initrd 1.4.3.

tasks.title: [RES-05] Guest memory pressure: no VM restart loop
tasks.description: Watchdog restarted the VM when dockerd stalled under full guest memory; with restart: unless-stopped containers this looped. Plus zombie shims, dockerd OOM priority, spk up --memory ignored in daemon mode.
tasks.details: Fixed in 545a39c, 1bc7870, 7b066a9. Verified on /tmp/spkt: SIGSTOP dockerd 85s -> VM survives with warning; reboot -f in guest -> detected and exit 1; OOM kill logged; zombies=0; dockerd/containerd adj=-500; conformance 30/30, egress 25/25.

tasks.title: Implement Profile Management System
tasks.description: Add support for named profiles with separate home directories, launchd labels, and docker contexts
tasks.details: Create a Profile struct in speck-cli that handles profile name validation (regex [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,31}), mapping of profile names to home directories (~/.speck/profiles/<name> for non-default), launchd labels (io.speck.vm.<name>), and docker contexts (speck-<name>). Implement command-line flag -p/--profile with env var SPECK_PROFILE support where flag takes precedence. Add validation to prevent SPECK_HOME + profile conflicts. Modify resolve_speck_home() to respect profile selection. Update commands to use the selected profile.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for name validation, home directory mapping, label/context generation, and conflict detection. Integration test with spk start -p work and docker --context speck-work ps

tasks.title: Add SSH Server to Guest Rootfs
tasks.description: Integrate dropbear SSH server into the guest rootfs and configure it to start on boot
tasks.details: Modify .github/workflows/build-rootfs.yml to include dropbear package in the rootfs build. Configure vminitd to start dropbear after switch_root with restart-with-backoff pattern. Set dropbear to listen only on 127.0.0.1:22, accept public-key auth only, log in as root, generate host key on first boot and store it on data disk. Mount Speck home via VirtioFS at /var/run and read authorized_keys from /var/run/ssh/authorized_keys. Implement fallback behavior if dropbear is missing.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify guest console shows dropbear started, test that SSH connections fail from outside the VM but work internally, ensure conformance and egress gates stay green

tasks.title: Implement SSH Key Generation and Socket Proxy
tasks.description: Generate SSH keys on start and implement Unix socket proxy for SSH connections
tasks.details: Add logic to generate ed25519 key pair at <home>/ssh/id_ed25519 if it doesn't exist, write public key to authorized_keys. Create Unix socket at <home>/ssh.sock that bridges to vsock 9006 with target line '127.0.0.1:22'. Implement eager-drain and 4MB buffer rules. Add hidden command spk ssh-proxy that connects to the socket and copies stdin/stdout both ways.
tasks.testStrategy: Test that key generation works on first start, verify ssh.sock exists and is functional, test connection through proxy with proper authentication

tasks.title: Implement spk ssh Command
tasks.description: Add the spk ssh command that executes system SSH with proper proxy configuration
tasks.details: Create new spk ssh command that execs system ssh with: -i <home>/ssh/id_ed25519, -o IdentitiesOnly=yes, -o ProxyCommand='<spk binary> ssh-proxy --profile <name>', -o UserKnownHostsFile=<home>/ssh/known_hosts, -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new, and connects to root@speck. Add check for running VM state with appropriate error message if not running.
tasks.testStrategy: Test interactive shell access works, test command execution like 'spk ssh -- uname -a', verify cross-profile SSH works, ensure proper error handling when VM is down

tasks.title: Implement spk ssh-config Command
tasks.description: Add command to generate OpenSSH config block for the selected profile
tasks.details: Create spk ssh-config command that prints OpenSSH configuration block with Host speck (or speck-<name>), User root, HostName speck, IdentityFile <home>/ssh/id_ed25519, IdentitiesOnly yes, UserKnownHostsFile <home>/ssh/known_hosts, StrictHostKeyChecking accept-new, and ProxyCommand using the correct spk binary path (brew symlink or current_exe()).
tasks.testStrategy: Test that output matches expected format for default and named profiles, verify SSH with generated config works, check VS Code Remote-SSH connectivity

tasks.title: Implement spk template Command
tasks.description: Add command to edit configuration files with validation
tasks.details: Create spk template command that opens <home>/config.yaml in $VISUAL, then $EDITOR, then vi. If file doesn't exist, create a commented template with all supported keys and defaults. Validate edited file against existing loader, print errors, offer re-edit option or keep file if invalid. Implement spk start --edit that runs same flow then starts the profile.
tasks.testStrategy: Test that template creation works on fresh install, verify validation catches invalid edits, test that --edit flag works with start

tasks.title: Implement Profile Lifecycle Commands
tasks.description: Add support for full profile lifecycle operations including delete and prune
tasks.details: Extend existing commands (start, stop, restart, delete, recreate, status, logs, doctor, env, init --set-docker-host, prune) to work with selected profile. Implement delete command that removes profile directory, plist, and docker context. Ensure list shows all profiles with correct state information.
tasks.testStrategy: Test that spk delete -p work removes all profile artifacts, verify spk list shows both default and named profiles, test restart after deletion works

tasks.title: Update Documentation and Smoke Tests
tasks.description: Add documentation for new features and create smoke tests to verify functionality
tasks.details: Create scripts/cli-smoke.sh that runs against live install: start throwaway profile, check list, ssh -- true, ssh-config output, ssh speck-<name> true, run template with EDITOR=true, delete profile. Update README with profiles section, spk ssh, spk ssh-config, and spk template documentation. Add manual testing documentation for VS Code Remote-SSH and two-profile reboot checks.
tasks.testStrategy: Run all smoke scripts (cli-smoke.sh, conformance-smoke.sh, egress-smoke.sh) to ensure they pass, verify documentation is accurate and complete

tasks.title: Ensure Release Compatibility and Testing
tasks.description: Prepare for release including rootfs updates, testing, and validation
tasks.details: Bump rootfs version in CLI to include dropbear changes. If vminitd changed, bump initrd tag. Update release process to include new rootfs tag, initrd tag if needed, CLI release, and tap formula update. Ensure cargo test --workspace, cargo clippy, and cargo fmt all pass with new code.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify all tests pass, ensure release artifacts are properly generated, confirm that brew upgrade flow works correctly with new functionality

tasks.title: spk profile commands and current profile
tasks.description: spk profile ls/use/current/create/rm; current profile stored in ~/.speck/current-profile; precedence -p > SPECK_PROFILE > file > default; lifecycle commands name the profile they act on
tasks.details: See PRD section 1 (current profile, spk profile subcommands). Name is spk profile, not spk context, to avoid clashing with docker contexts. Test: unit tests for precedence; profile use work, then bare spk status reports work.

tasks.title: CI mode: --no-autostart profiles and start --wait
tasks.description: Profiles with autostart: false run detached without a launchd plist; spk start --wait returns once the Docker API answers for every profile; early error on socket paths over 104 bytes
tasks.details: See PRD section 1 (CI / ephemeral profiles). Test: start a --no-autostart profile, docker ps works, no plist, delete --force removes everything.

tasks.title: Global -o plain|json|yaml output
tasks.description: One global output flag for status, list/profile ls, profile current, config, version, doctor; --json stays as alias; stdout holds only the document in json/yaml mode; exit codes independent of format
tasks.details: See PRD section 5a. Test: spk status -o json | jq; spk config -o yaml; invalid config in json mode exits 1; unit tests of document shapes.
